Molecular features favoring BBB penetration: moderate lipophilicity (logP 1-3) provides the driving force for passive diffusion across the endothelial lipid bilayer. Charged molecules at pH 7.4 (carboxylates, sulfonates, phosphates, quaternary amines) have very poor passive BBB penetration. High molecular weight (> 500 Da).
